feature.title: Fix booking service correctness, reliability, and performance issues

tasks.title: Fix booking.service.js: propagate original error in pre-submit check
tasks.description: In bookSlot(), the pre-submit event type check swallows the original error: `const [et, etErr] = await getEventType(hostId, eventTypeId).unwrap(); if (etErr) throw new Error('Unable to verify event type — please try again')`. The original etErr is discarded. Fix: include original error as cause and log it via tapErr.
acceptanceCriteria: Pre-submit check errors include original error as cause: `new Error('...', { cause: etErr })`
User-facing message remains friendly
Original error logged via console.error or tapErr for debugging
Event type existence check handles null et (event not found) separately from read errors

tasks.title: Fix booking.service.js: add host-bookings index to eliminate full-table scans
tasks.description: listBookingsForHost() and listBookingsForInvitee() both read ALL bookings then filter client-side. This is O(n) where n = all bookings in the system. Fix: add a /host_bookings/{hostId}/{bid} index node that stores `true` for each booking. Update book-slot.js Cloud Function to write this index when creating a booking. Service reads the index (only that host's booking IDs), then batch-reads the actual bookings.
acceptanceCriteria: listBookingsForHost() reads /host_bookings/{hostId} only, not /bookings
listBookingsForInvitee() reads /invitee_bookings/{inviteeId} only
book-slot.js Cloud Function writes to /host_bookings/{hostId}/{bid} and /invitee_bookings/{inviteeId}/{bid}
cancelBooking() removes from index nodes
database.rules.json updated: host_bookings.$hostId.write requires auth.uid === $hostId
Query time for 1000-bookings host: under 200ms (was potentially seconds)

tasks.title: Fix booking.service.js: arrow anti-pattern and ambiguous indentation in bookSlot
tasks.description: The bookSlot function has ambiguous indentation: the PHI handling block at lines 74-91 looks like it's inside the `if (!resp.ok)` block but is actually outside it. The `if (!resp.ok)` block at line 65 throws on error, so execution only reaches PHI handling on success — but this isn't visually clear. Fix with guard clause pattern: `if (!resp.ok) { /* handle all error cases, return or throw */ }` then happy path (success + PHI handling) runs flat.
acceptanceCriteria: Error handling extracted to top of function with clear throw/return
Happy path (success response + PHI split) at leftmost indentation
No ambiguous indentation — if block clearly terminates before success path
Function under 50 lines after refactor

tasks.title: Add client-side retry for booking Cloud Function call
tasks.description: bookSlot() calls the Cloud Function via fetch() with a 15s timeout but no retry for transient failures (network errors, 503, cold start timeout). Add 1 retry with 1s backoff for transient errors. Do NOT retry on 4xx (validation errors) or 409 (slot_taken — retry would be useless).
acceptanceCriteria: Transient errors (network failure, 5xx, AbortError) → retry once after 1s
4xx errors → fail immediately, no retry
409 Conflict (slot_taken, slot_missing) → fail immediately, no retry
Max 2 total attempts
Total timeout: 15s per attempt = 30s max
Retry attempt logged to console for observability
